description: Kiswahili names for the liturgical seasons, colours and every celebration id the calendar can produce (General Roman Calendar plus regional overrides). Read by @lectio/calendar (packages/calendar/src/i18n) and written into calendar/<year>.json as names.sw, with the entry's status as names.swStatus. Each entry has a status: "provisional" (drafted, waiting for review by a native speaker against the KCCB Kiswahili Ordo), "reviewed" (checked by a native speaker) or "fallback" (no Kiswahili name yet: "name" is null and the English name is shown instead).

sources.title: Common Kiswahili Catholic liturgical usage in Kenya and Tanzania
sources.notes: Seasons and days follow the usage of Kiswahili missals, Ordos and parish booklets: Dominika (Sunday), Juma (week), Majilio (Advent), Noeli (Christmas), Kwaresima (Lent), Pasaka (Easter), Mwaka (Ordinary Time), Juma Kuu (Holy Week), Mtakatifu (Saint), Mwenyeheri (Blessed). The KCCB Kiswahili Ordo is not published online, so no entry has been checked against it yet.
